name: Lelisu LS-212 Wireless Stereo Headphones | Bluetooth Headset for Smartphones, Tablets & MP3/MP4
description:
The Lelisu LS-212 Wireless Stereo Headphones combine style, comfort, and performance to deliver a complete audio experience. Equipped with Bluetooth technology, they ensure seamless connectivity with smartphones, tablets, MP3/MP4 players, laptops, and more. Featuring rich bass, clear treble, and immersive stereo sound, the LS-212 is perfect for music, calls, gaming, and daily use. Its lightweight build and cushioned ear pads provide hours of comfortable listening, while the built-in microphone allows hands-free calling and voice assistant access. With long battery life and universal compatibility, these headphones are ideal for work, travel, and entertainment.
Key Features
 Wireless Bluetooth connectivity for fast and stable pairing
 Stereo sound with deep bass and clear treble
 Lightweight design with cushioned ear pads for comfort
 Built-in microphone for hands-free calls and voice commands
 Long-lasting battery for extended playtime
 Universal compatibility with iOS, Android, Windows, and more
How to Use
 Turn on headphones and enable Bluetooth
 Pair with your device following instructions
 Adjust headband and ear pads for comfort
 Use built-in controls for calls and music
Material
High-quality ABS, soft cushioned ear pads, electronic components
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Keep away from water and extreme heat
 Avoid prolonged high-volume usage
 Keep out of reach of children
Package Includes
 1 × Lelisu LS-212 Wireless Stereo Headphones
 1 × USB Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
